cards.name: The Ur-Dragon
questions: Eminence: 'in the command zone or on the battlefield' is a static `while` of source_state on_battlefield OR a command-zone zone_count of the card itself. The schema has no way to say an ability works from two zones, so this is how the command-zone half is expressed.

cards.name: Dracogenesis
questions: 'Cast Dragon spells without paying their mana costs' is a scripted marker; the schema has no static modifier for a free-cast permission on other cards' spells (castOptions only describe the card's own casting).

cards.name: Goldspan Dragon
questions: 'Becomes the target of a spell' (not an ability) has no field on the becomes_target trigger; written as plain becomes_target self.
'Two mana of any one color' is written {anyColor:2} (any combination); the schema has no 'all the same color' flag on ManaSpec.

cards.name: Balefire Dragon
questions: 'Each creature that player controls' is written as a damage_target all:true with who:'that_player' plus a creature filter (the filter has no 'controlled by that player' value).

cards.name: Ancient Copper Dragon
questions: Rolling dice has no step kind or Quantity: the ability carries a scripted marker roll_d20_result_is_X and the roll result is bound to X (same on Ancient Silver/Gold/Brass Dragon).

cards.name: Call the Spirit Dragons
questions: 'For each color, put a counter on a Dragon of that color' and the 'if five Dragons, you win the game' clause have no vocabulary (no win_game step, no iterate-over-colors); a scripted marker carries the win threshold and the counter step is a simplified repeat_for_each.

cards.name: Morophon, the Boundless
questions: {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} cost reduction affecting only colored mana: costMod.delta is a number, so the colored-only rule is a scripted marker (delta -5 is a stand-in).

cards.name: Tiamat
questions: 'If you cast it' is a stat predicate was_cast (no dedicated predicate). 'Not named Tiamat' and 'each have different names' are the step fields excludeNamed and distinctNames (ObjectFilter has no notNamed).

cards.name: Scion of Draco
questions: Domain (distinct basic land types) cannot be counted by a costReduction.per filter; the scripted marker domain_count_distinct_basic_land_types makes it count distinct types. Per-color keyword grants ('vigilance if white, hexproof if blue...') have no conditional grant: the five grants are listed without their color gates.

cards.name: Rivaz of the Claw
questions: 'May cast a Dragon creature spell from your graveyard once each turn' is a scripted permission marker (castOptions only describe the card's own casting).

cards.name: Silumgar, the Drifting Death
questions: 'Creatures defending player controls' is written who:'that_player' (the defending player); PlayerRef has no defending_player value.

cards.name: Scalelord Reckoner
questions: 'A spell or ability an opponent controls' is an interveningIf matches on event_object (the targeting source) controller=opponent; 'that player controls' is just controller:opponent.

cards.name: Rith, Liberated Primeval
questions: 'Was dealt excess damage this turn' (to an opponent's creature/planeswalker) has no predicate; interveningIf did_this_turn dealt_damage + the scripted marker excess_damage_dealt_to_opponent_creature_or_planeswalker.

cards.name: Ancient Silver Dragon
questions: 'For the rest of the game' has no Duration value; written as duration {until:'unspecified'} on a grant_effect with the player as the target.

cards.name: Terror of the Peaks
questions: 'Cost an additional 3 life' for opponents' spells that target this creature is a scripted marker: costMod only changes mana, and no static modifier adds a life cost to other players' spells.

cards.name: Twinflame Tyrant
questions: Recipient 'an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls' is one filter controller:opponent; the recipient field cannot mix a player and a permanent filter.

cards.name: Scion of the Ur-Dragon
questions: 'Dragon permanent card' written as subtypes Dragon + creature (Dragon is only a creature subtype); the copy target is the found card (ref 'chosen').

cards.name: Ramos, Dragon Engine
questions: 'For each of that spell's colors' has no Quantity; amount is event_amount with the scripted marker count_spell_colors.

cards.name: Ancient Brass Dragon
questions: 'Any number of target creature cards with total mana value X or less' is a target spec with count 0..99; the total-mana-value cap is not expressible (X is the roll via the scripted marker).

cards.name: Ganax, Astral Hunter
questions: Choose a Background is a deck-building rule (second commander); written as a keyword with a scripted marker, no play effect.

cards.name: Thrakkus the Butcher
questions: 'Double the power of each Dragon' = repeat_for_each over Dragons you control with pump_target by its own power; event_object stands for the object currently iterated (no dedicated ObjRef for the loop variable).

cards.name: Hellkite Tyrant
questions: 'Twenty' (and 'win the game') cannot be plain numbers/steps: the win is a scripted marker win_the_game; the 20 is in the interveningIf count (the validator's number-word table may complain).

cards.name: Zurgo and Ojutai
questions: 'Entered this turn' is a stat predicate entered_this_turn (no dedicated predicate). 'A player or battle' damage is written as the player-damage event only (no battle recipient).

cards.name: Scavenger Regent // Exude Toxin
questions: Exude Toxin (Omen back half; its cost {X}{B}{B} comes from the card face, not the oracle text) is a spell_effect ability usable from hand; the 'shuffle this card into its owner's library' rider is a shuffle step targeting self. Omen has no dedicated cast-option kind.

cards.name: Crucible of the Spirit Dragon
questions: Crucible's X mana is an activated ability with an add_mana step (kind 'mana' cannot carry a variable amount); rules-wise it is a mana ability.

cards.name: Arena of Glory
questions: Exert is not a cost atom; it is carried by the scripted marker exert_and_haste_if_spent_on_creature_spell (which also holds the haste-on-creature-spell rider on the mana).

cards.name: Mistrise Village
questions: 'The next spell you cast this turn can't be countered' is a grant_effect on the player with a scripted marker next_spell_this_turn_cant_be_countered (no 'next spell' ObjRef).

cards.name: Path of Ancestry
questions: The 'when that mana is spent' trigger is a cast trigger plus a scripted marker (no way to link a trigger to the mana it came from, and no 'shares a creature type with your commander' filter value other than sharesCreatureTypeWith an ObjRef).

cards.name: Exotic Orchard
questions: 'Any color that a land an opponent controls could produce' (also Reflecting Pool) has no ManaSpec; written {anyColor:1} plus a scripted marker naming the restriction.

cards.name: Myriad Landscape
questions: 'Share a land type' between the two fetched basics is a scripted marker (cards_share_a_land_type); ObjectFilter.sameName is the only group qualifier.

cards.name: Orb of Dragonkind
questions: Mana restriction 'Dragon spells or abilities of Dragons' is a filter {subtypes:['Dragon']} (no spell-or-ability distinction in ManaSpec.restriction). OK?

cards.name: Hellkite Charger
questions: SCHEMA QUESTION: no step kind for 'additional combat phase'; marked with scripted handler additional_combat_phase on the ability (same for Scourge of the Throne). Add a step kind?

cards.name: Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind
questions: A mana ability with a rider effect: 'it' is the Dragon spell the mana was spent on (event_object). The schema has no way to say 'mana was spent on X'; I used a matches predicate on the spell. OK?

cards.name: Scourge of the Throne
questions: SCHEMA QUESTION: 'the player with the most life or tied for most life' is written as life(that_player) >= greatest life of any player, using a pseudo-filter {types:['player']}. Needs a proper Quantity/Predicate. 'Additional combat phase' is a scripted marker (see Hellkite Charger).
'This creature attacks the player' = that_player (the defending player).

decisions: Copied unchanged from other decks' drafts (identical cards): Dragon Tempest (reign-of-dragons), Scourge of Valkas (reign-of-dragons), Lathliss, Dragon Queen (reign-of-dragons), Dragon's Hoard (reign-of-dragons), Garruk's Uprising (tramplesaurus-rex), Dragonspeaker Shaman (reign-of-dragons), Dragonlord's Servant (reign-of-dragons), Utvara Hellkite (reign-of-dragons), Dragonstorm Globe (reign-of-dragons), Orb of Dragonkind (reign-of-dragons), Hellkite Charger (reign-of-dragons), Sarkhan's Triumph (reign-of-dragons), Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind (reign-of-dragons), Scourge of the Throne (reign-of-dragons), Temple of the False God (calling-all-angels), Bojuka Bog (wretched-ranks), Rogue's Passage (tramplesaurus-rex), War Room (calling-all-angels), Swamp (wretched-ranks), Forest (tramplesaurus-rex), Mountain (reign-of-dragons), Island (keen-engineering), Plains (calling-all-angels).
SCHEMA QUESTION: no Roll step or roll-result Quantity (Ancient Copper/Silver/Gold/Brass Dragon): scripted marker roll_d20_result_is_X with the result bound to X.
SCHEMA QUESTION: no win_the_game step (Call the Spirit Dragons, Hellkite Tyrant): scripted marker.

SCHEMA QUESTION: no way to express a dual-colour tap ability ("Add {W} or {U}"): written as two mana abilities with identical text (player picks one). ManaSpec has no one-of or all-same-colour (Goldspan Treasure) flag.

SCHEMA QUESTION: no exert cost atom (Arena of Glory), no loop-variable ObjRef for repeat_for_each (Thrakkus), no was_cast / entered_this_turn / excess-damage predicates (Tiamat, Zurgo and Ojutai, Rith), no defending_player PlayerRef (Silumgar), no notNamed filter, no free-cast static modifier (Dracogenesis), no cast-other-cards-from-zone permission (Rivaz, Korlessa), no additional life cost on opponents spells (Terror of the Peaks), no colored-only cost reduction (Morophon), no domain count.

VALIDATOR NOTE: number words (twenty, five-with-math) and digits in costMod/count need the {math:max} wrapper trick; mana symbols for a second card face (Exude Toxin {X}{B}{B}) are not in the oracle text, so no cast option is written for it.
